```{r}
#| eval: true

library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

supply_chain <- data.frame(
  Role = c(
    "Cleaner/Aggregator",
    "Cleaner/Aggregator", "Cleaner/Aggregator", "Cleaner/Aggregator",
    "Cleaner/Aggregator",
    "Primary",
    "Secondary",
    "Secondary",
    "Secondary",
    "Secondary",
    "Wholesaler",
    "Wholesaler"
  ),
  Product = c(
    "All",
    "Small red, kidney", "Black/navy", "Cranberry",
    "", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""
  ),
  Shrinkage = c(
    "5%",
    "6-7%", "5%", "18%",
    "10-15%",
    "1%",
    "0%",
    "Less than 2%",
    "Less than 1%",
    "Less than 1%",
    "Less than 1%",
    "2-3%"
  )
)

supply_chain %>%
  kbl(
    align = "lll",
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left",
    font_size = 13
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4a7c59", color = "white") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
```
